narr: A low pressure system of tropical origin moved northward into the area and combined with deep moisture to produce an afternoon of thunderstorms. These storms produced accumulating hail and heavy rainfall.
ev: Video and pictures from a fire department employee and public show Buckskin Ct road flooding along with multiple houses and stables in the vicinity.
Nevada DOT reported minor debris and flooding on both directions of US-395 with both lanes blocked.
